info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Model By Param1-spec
info.description: The Contribution Model Update API allows clients to modify specific attributes of contribution models based on the provided parameter. This endpoint is particularly useful for financial institutions and banking systems needing to adjust model configurations dynamically. Users can update settings such as interest rates, fees, or eligibility criteria. Typical consumers of this API include developers building banking applications or services that require real-time model adjustments to enhance customer offerings.
